asked.item: Is there something on the Bluesky side to set up before videos work
Video format and URL requirements for a Bluesky video post

verdict.reason: The help pages state the Bluesky email verification requirement for posting videos and the supported video formats and URL rules, which answer the setup question; they do not say why this specific post failed.

steps.text: Yes, to post videos to Bluesky through Blotato, you must verify your email address with Bluesky.
Bluesky videos must be in MP4, WebM, or MOV format, and each Bluesky post supports one video.
The public media URL for the video must end in .mp4, .webm, or .mov so Blotato recognizes it as a video.
